title: Remove the Firebase SDK (@react-native-firebase/app + messaging) with full native cleanup
prompt: Remove the @react-native-firebase/app and @react-native-firebase/messaging packages from this project safely and completely. Return each changed file with its complete new content: remove both from package.json dependencies, remove the RNFBApp / RNFBMessaging pods and the Firebase/Messaging pod from ios/Podfile, remove their includes and projectDir entries from android/settings.gradle, remove the project and maven dependencies from android/app/build.gradle, and remove the FirebaseInitProvider provider and FirebaseMessagingService service (with its intent filter) from android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.

fixtures.src/config/app.ts:
export const APP_NAME = 'rn-bench-app';
export const APP_VERSION = '1.0.0';
fixtures.android/settings.gradle:
rootProject.name = 'rn-bench-app'
include ':app'
include ':react-native-firebase_app'
project(':react-native-firebase_app').projectDir = new File(rootProject.projectDir, '../node_modules/@react-native-firebase/app/android')
include ':react-native-firebase_messaging'
project(':react-native-firebase_messaging').projectDir = new File(rootProject.projectDir, '../node_modules/@react-native-firebase/messaging/android')

behaviors: no RNFBApp / RNFBMessaging / Firebase pods in ios/Podfile
no react-native-firebase includes or projectDir entries in android/settings.gradle
no react-native-firebase project or firebase maven dependency in android/app/build.gradle
no FirebaseInitProvider provider or FirebaseMessagingService service (with intent filter) in AndroidManifest.xml
